description: This file defines the custom view class 'FractionalLinearLayout' that extends Android's LinearLayout. It is designed to facilitate animations where the layout's position is specified as a fraction of the device's height, enabling smooth fragment animations across different device sizes.

classes.name: FractionalLinearLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that supports setting its vertical position as a fraction of the screen height for animation purposes.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Overrides the method to capture the new height and update the layout's y position accordingly.

methods.name: getYFraction
methods.description: Returns the current yFraction used for vertical positioning.

methods.name: setYFraction
methods.description: Sets the y position as a fraction of total height, enabling smooth animation.
